name: Data Processing Addendum
description: Fontara's data processing addendum as processor for a customer (sell side): international transfers add the standard contractual clauses only when personal data leaves the EEA or the UK, the sub-processor notice is 30 days or (fallback) 60 days with a right to object, and the breach notice is 72 hours or (fallback, as the Clause Library's Data Privacy and Security fallback) 24 hours. Governing law follows the contracting entity.

template: This Data Processing Addendum is made on {{DPA Effective Date}} between {{Legal Entity}} ("Processor") and {{Customer Legal Name}}, {{Customer Address}} ("Controller"), and forms part of the {{Agreement}}.
1. Processing. Processor processes the following personal data only on Controller's documented instructions and only to provide the services: {{Categories of Personal Data}}
2. Security. Processor keeps appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encryption in transit and at rest, access control and staff confidentiality.

template.text: 3. Sub-processors. Processor may engage sub-processors and gives Controller 30 days' notice of a new one.

3. Sub-processors. Processor gives Controller 60 days' notice of a new sub-processor. Controller may object on reasonable data protection grounds and, if the parties cannot resolve the objection, terminate the affected services without penalty.
4. Personal data breaches. Processor notifies Controller without undue delay, and in any case within 72 hours, after becoming aware of a personal data breach.
4. Personal data breaches. Processor shall notify Controller of any personal data breach within 24 hours of discovering it. Controller may audit Processor's data handling practices once a year.

5. International transfers. Where personal data is transferred outside the EEA or the UK, the parties incorporate the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2, controller to processor) and the UK International Data Transfer Addendum, and Processor keeps a transfer impact assessment.
